institution: Institute of Science and Technology Austria (ISTA)

app_fee.value: No application fee is stated on the official admissions, FAQ or applicant-guide pages; ISTA says only that it charges no tuition fees.

fee_waiver.value: No application fee is stated, so no fee waiver rule is given.

gre_general.value: Indian applicants need no GRE: ISTA does not ask for a GRE or an English test score.
gre_general.quote: Do I need to submit a TOEFL/IELTS or GRE score? | No, you do not.

toefl_min.value: No TOEFL is required; ISTA asks for no formal English certificate, though the program is taught entirely in English.
toefl_min.quote: A formal proof of competence in English (IELTS, CPE or TOEFL) is not required.

also.quote: Language tests such as TOEFL, IELTS etc. are not mandatory.

ielts_min.value: No IELTS is required; ISTA asks for no formal English certificate, though the program is taught entirely in English.
ielts_min.quote: A formal proof of competence in English (IELTS, CPE or TOEFL) is not required.

also.quote: Language tests such as TOEFL, IELTS etc. are not mandatory.

english_waiver.value: No English test is required of any applicant, so an English-medium Indian degree needs no waiver.
english_waiver.quote: A formal proof of competence in English (IELTS, CPE or TOEFL) is not required.

notes: One intake per year. Applicants must show proficiency in written and oral English, which is checked at interview. Master's en-route to PhD is an optional component. The official admissions page (phd.ista.ac.at/phd-application-admission/) returned HTTP 503 on the first two attempts and was fetched on a retry; its content gives no fee.
